en: Who is it?
Dad.
Come on in, Dad.
I thought you might be hungry.
I brought you a chicken sandwich and a glass of milk.
cn: 我给你带了鸡肉三明治和一杯牛奶。

en: I am hungry. Thanks, Dad.
What time is it, anyway?
Ten o'clock. What are you working on?
I'm writing a story for the high school paper.
cn: 我在给校报写一篇文章。

en: Can't you finish it tomorrow?
No. I have to turn it in in the morning.
What's it about?
I'm writing an article on the feelings about graduation.
cn: 我在写一篇关于毕业感受的文章。

en: And how do you feel?
Me?
A little scared and excited, too.
I felt the same way.
The scary part is leaving home and moving to college.
Oh, leaving home is part of growing up.
cn: 哦，离家是成长的一部分。

en: Don't work all night.
I don't mind. I enjoy writing.
Maybe you should think about becoming a writer.
cn: 也许你该考虑当个作家。

en: Maybe I should.
You have lots of time to decide.
That's the worst part, making decisions.
You'll be okay. Good night, son.
Good night, Dad.
Good morning, Robbie. Good morning, Dad.
How's my grandson?
Fine, Grandpa. Fine.
What's all the cheering about?
Did the University of Michigan win another football game?
cn: 密歇根大学又赢了橄榄球赛吗？

en: Better than that. Tell me, Philip.
I just spoke with Charlie Raefer.
cn: 我刚和 Charley Rafer 通过话。

en: Who's Charlie Raefer?
He's the Dean of Admissions for the University of Michigan.
cn: 他是密歇根大学的招生处长。

en: And it turns out he's a classmate of Philip's.
cn: 原来他是 Philip 的同学。

en: Yeah, we were both on the tennis team.
Great.
It is great. He's going to be in New York tomorrow to interview applicants for admission.
And he's agreed to fit you into his schedule.
cn: 他同意把你加进他的日程。

en: But I may not want to go to Michigan.
cn: 但我可能不想去密歇根。

en: It's one of the best schools in the country, Robbie.
cn: 那是全国最好的学校之一，Robbie。

en: I studied medicine there. Your grandfather went to the engineering school there.
cn: 你爷爷在那里的工学院。

en: I know that, but...
You said you wanted to be a doctor like your father.
cn: 你说过想当医生，像你爸爸一样。

en: Not exactly.
But you couldn't pick a finer medical school than Michigan.
cn: 你找不到比密歇根更好的医学院了。

en: Yes, I know that.
Let's meet with Charlie at the University Club.
cn: 我们在大学俱乐部和 Charley 见面吧。

en: 10 o'clock tomorrow morning.
It doesn't mean you're going to Michigan.
cn: 这不意味着你要去密歇根。

en: It doesn't mean you have to be a doctor.
cn: 也不意味着你必须当医生。

en: But the interview will be good experience for you.
cn: 但这次面试对你来说会是很好的经验。

en: In that case, it's okay.
Dad, growing up means making my own decisions, doesn't it?
You're right, Robbie.
But, like your grandpa suggested, have the interview.
And then make your own decision.
That sounds fine.
I know it's sudden, Robbie, but this is an important opportunity.
We'll head down there first thing tomorrow morning, okay?
Sure, Dad.
I want you to know something, son.
Thanks, Dad.
I've got an appointment at the hospital.
I'll see you all at dinner time.
Bye, Dad.
Is something still wrong, Robbie?
I'll be okay.
Going away to college for the first time
always makes one a little nervous.
I guess so.
I'll be okay.
I just need time to think.
cn: 我会没事的，我只是需要时间想想。

en: Oh, sorry, Robbie.
Sorry to be late this morning, but, uh,
cn: 对不起，Robbie，对不起今早迟到，

en: well, we've still got some time for a cup of coffee.
cn: 不过，我们还有时间喝杯咖啡。

en: I can't wait to see my old pal, Charlie Raper.
cn: 我等不及要见老朋友 Charley Rafer。

en: Neither can I.
So you thought about it, huh?
Yes, I have, Dad.
Well, I'm glad.
I knew you'd realize that this interview
could be an important experience for you.
cn: 这次面试对你来说可能是重要的经历。

en: I came to that conclusion.
That's very wise, Robbie.
Very wise.
Now let's, uh, let's head off to the city and university club.
cn: 现在我们出发去城里、去大学俱乐部吧。

en: Thanks, Dad.
Thanks? For what?
Thanks for hearing me out.
And...
And?
And thanks for being such an understanding father.
Well, thank you, Robbie.
Thank you.
Philip Stewart.
It's great to see you.
Charlie Raper, you look as young as ever.
cn: Charley Rafer——你看起来和以前一样年轻。

en: Ha, ha, ha, ha.
Ha, ha, ha.
You must be Robbie.
Hi.
Yes, this is my younger son, Robbie.
cn: 是的，这是我小儿子 Robbie。

en: Robbie, I want you to meet
one of the best tennis players on the Michigan team.
cn: 密歇根网球队最棒的球员之一——

en: Charlie Raper.
Nice to meet you, Dean Raper.
cn: 很高兴认识你，Rafer 主任。

en: Well, are you as good a tennis player as your dad?
cn: 嗯，你网球打得和你爸爸一样好吗？

en: No, I'm not very good at it.
Frankly, neither was I.
Charlie was the star of the team.
Yeah, thanks.
Well, how have you been, Philip?
Oh, working too hard.
Doesn't show.
How's Ellen?
Fine, thank you.
And how's Marge?
She's still giving the toughest English history exams in the school
cn: 她还在出学校里最难的英国史考题，

en: and loving every minute of it.
Ha, ha, ha.
And speaking of minutes,
I have interviews until noon,
so why don't we get right to work?
cn: 那我们为什么不直接开始呢？

en: Can you have lunch with us later?
cn: 您待会儿能和我们一起午餐吗？

en: I'd love to, Philip, but I'm afraid I can't.
I'm only here two days,
and I have interviews with 26 applicants.
I understand. Well, thanks.
I'll wait outside.
Good luck, son.
Did you bring your transcript from high school?
cn: 你带高中的成绩单了吗？

en: Yes, sir, right here.
Thank you.
Please, sit down.
I see under activities that you've been writing for the school paper.
Yes, sir.
What kind of articles have you written?
All kinds, sports,
cn: 各种——体育、社论、戏剧评论。

en: um, editorials, theater reviews.
You name it, I've written it.
Have you ever thought of becoming a journalist?
cn: 嗯，你有没有想过当记者？

en: Professional writer?
Not until recently.
Michigan has a fine school of journalism.
cn: 密歇根有很好的新闻学院。

en: Yes, I know that.
You seem to have some reservations.
I'm a little uncertain.
And it's been very nice talking to you.
Nice talking to you, sir.
One piece of advice.
Most important thing is for you to decide your own future.
cn: 最重要的是你自己决定未来。

en: Yes, sir.
Goodbye, Dean Rayford.
Goodbye, Robbie.
Good luck.
I had an interview today, too.
I had a great interview with admissions at Columbia University.
cn: 是哥伦比亚大学招生办。

en: Really? What did they say?
Will you get into the school?
Well, they didn't say anything for sure,
but I figured that with my grades and with my personality,
cn: 但我想凭我的成绩和性格，

en: I'll have no problem.
Columbia's a terrific school.
cn: 哥伦比亚是个很棒的学校。

en: What are you going to do?
Do? I don't know.
I also applied to NYU.
You sound excited about Columbia.
cn: 你听起来对哥伦比亚很兴奋。

en: What's your problem, Mike?
Indecision.
Indecision.
It's not easy, and this is an important decision we have to make.
cn: 而这是个我们得做的重要决定。

en: And what about you?
How was your interview with Michigan?
The interview was fine.
It was a great college.
It is.
My father would like me to go there.
He and my grandpa both went there.
cn: 他和我爷爷都去过那里。

en: Great medical school, too.
I know.
You can follow in your father's footsteps.
I'd like to follow in my own footsteps, Mike.
What do you want to study?
I've been thinking.
I think I want to study journalism,
to be a reporter, a newspaper man.
You do a pretty good job on the Riverdale High School paper.
cn: 你在 Riverdale 高中校报上做得很好。

en: And I've been thinking about it a lot lately.
cn: 我最近一直在想这件事。

en: Have you discussed it with your parents?
No, but I have to.
Okay. Let's talk.
Hi, son.
Hi, Dad. Everything's fine.
I was just waiting for you to get home so we could talk.
Anything special you want to talk about?
There is, Dad.
I'm listening.
Well, I know you and Mom have given up a lot
cn: 嗯，我知道你和妈妈付出了很多，

en: to save money for my college tuition.
We want you to go to college, Robbie.
I know. I do.
Thought a lot about which college.
cn: 嗯，我考虑了很多上哪所大学，

en: And one of them is Columbia.
Columbia? Why Columbia?
cn: 哥伦比亚？为什么是哥伦比亚？

en: First, they have an excellent school of journalism.
cn: 首先，他们有出色的新闻学院。

en: Mm-hmm. They do.
And your friends are planning to go to Columbia?
cn: 你朋友们也打算去哥伦比亚？

en: That's only part of it.
It's complicated. I'll try to explain.
Mike and I had a hamburger this afternoon and we talked.
cn: Mike 和我今天下午吃了汉堡，聊了聊。

en: Yes?
Well, we talked about a lot of things.
He applied to Columbia and his interview was very successful.
He thinks he'll be accepted and he really wants to go there.
Dean Rayfer called me today.
He told me he was very impressed with you.
cn: Rafer 主任今天给我打电话了。

en: He's a nice man. He was very kind.
He told me you had some doubts about wanting to go to Michigan.
Yes, I do.
cn: 你对上密歇根有些疑虑。

en: I'm just not sure about what I want to do.
It's okay.
You understand?
Let me tell you something, Robbie.
Something that might be surprising to you.
What? Tell me.
Grandpa wanted me to study engineering like him.
I wasn't clear about my future, but I knew engineering was not for me.
What did you tell Grandpa?
cn: 但我知道工程不适合我。

en: The truth.
Then you're not upset about my not wanting to go into medicine?
I'm not upset at all.
I'm just happy that we're able to talk about it.
I am too, Dad.
cn: 我很高兴我们能谈这件事。

en: I suppose you want to apply to Columbia.
Yes, but I also want to apply to several other colleges.
cn: 我想你要申请哥伦比亚。

en: I thought you wanted to go to Columbia.
cn: 是的，但我也想申请其他几所学校。

en: Well, I might want to go to Columbia, and I might not.
cn: 我以为你想去哥伦比亚。

en: I just want to be able to make my own decision.
You're a real steward.
cn: 我只是想能自己做决定。

en: And if I think about it long enough, you never know.
Never know what?
cn: 如果我考虑得够久，谁知道呢……

en: If I make my own decision, I might choose Michigan.
Robbie, you're something.
You know, when I was your age, I said exactly the same thing to Grandpa.
cn: 你知道吗，我在你这个年纪，
